before:
namespace_engine_original_sources_r1:
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[hia-ci:') ||
      contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[hia-ci:all]') ||
      contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[hia-ci:namespace-engine-original-sources]')
    name: Read complete four original namespace engines without target execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Require the original Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 execution domain
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          . /etc/os-release
          test "$ID" = ubuntu
          test "$VERSION_ID" = 24.04
          test "$(uname -m)" = x86_64
          test "${ImageOS:?}" = ubuntu24
          printf 'HIA_RUNNER_DOMAIN id=%s version=%s architecture=%s image=%s image_version=%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID" "$(uname -m)" "$ImageOS" "${ImageVersion:?}"
      - name: Check out submitted diagnostic or reader
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install exact CPython 3.12.14
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12.14'
      - name: Execute bounded independent evidence task
        shell: bash
        env:
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
          HIA_CI_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-namespace-engine-original-sources
        run: timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 180s python -B review-evidence/hia-native-rewrite-20261111/remote-recovery-r3/namespace-ci/namespace-four-engine-original-sources-readback.py 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/hia-namespace-engine-original-sources-driver.log"
      - name: Retain original input and complete new evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hia-namespace-engine-original-sources-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-namespace-engine-original-sources
            ${{ runner.temp }}/hia-namespace-engine-original-sources-driver.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
          compression-level: 0
after:
